result.content:
# Proposed discovery plan

Whether to build a dedicated handoff tracking tool tailored for small software development teams in Latvia.

## Proposed scope

- Discovery focused on small software engineering teams operating in Latvia.
- Assessment of recurring handoff practices, timing, and administrative overhead.
- Evaluation of existing tooling workflows and integration requirements.
- Exclusion of any payroll, compensation, or financial advisory functionality.

Region: Latvia

Explicit exclusions: Do not include payroll or financial advice

## Engineering Lead

Oversees sprint workflows, technical coordination, and cross-developer task transitions.

- How much time does your team currently spend assembling and transferring status updates before handoffs or weekend transitions? (question-f98c0ce4b3ee074b29a4af6c)
- Which tools do you currently rely on for tracking handoffs, and what information typically gets dropped or duplicated? (question-8fa42b5b85be798e4f1b3774)

## Operations / Delivery Manager

Manages operational efficiency, tooling budgets, and delivery continuity across development squads.

- Under what conditions would your organization adopt a standalone handoff tracker instead of using existing project management software? (question-18873b5733301f1123be3372)

## Simulation hypotheses

- We spend two hours copying handoff updates each Friday. [source:operator-interview]

## Assumptions

- Small software development teams in Latvia encounter manual overhead when consolidating end-of-week updates, consistent with the synthetic fixture.
- Engineering leads have operational authority to evaluate and introduce targeted workflow coordination utilities.

## Evidence gaps

- No verified data on software development team sizing, tool stacks, or software procurement spending in Latvia.
- Absence of validated customer willingness to pay specifically for handoff automation in the target region.
- No non-synthetic source findings were established; the plan is a proposal, not customer validation.

This scope is proposed, not a claim of user approval.

## Selected sources

- [source:operator-interview] Synthetic operator interview fixture — synthetic_transcript
